heroHeadline: Trump Tells Iran 'Just Give Up'; Brent Tops $126 as CENTCOM Prepares Strike Options — Day 62
heroSubtitle: President Trump told Axios on April 30 — Day 62 — that Iran must 'just give up' and cannot have a nuclear weapon, as CENTCOM was reported to be preparing fresh military strike options for his review ahead of the War Powers Resolution 60-day deadline expiring May 1. Brent crude briefly topped $126 per barrel — the highest of the conflict — while WTI rose to $109.64 and US gasoline hit $4.30/gallon, a near four-year high. Treasury Secretary Bessent warned Kharg Island oil terminal is near storage capacity, costing Iran $170 million per day in lost revenue. Secretary of Defense Hegseth testified before the Senate Armed Services Committee for a second day, confirming the war has cost $25 billion and defending the mission as Democrats challenged his account. In Lebanon, IDF airstrikes killed at least 14 people on April 30 and a Hezbollah drone wounded 12 IDF soldiers near the northern border. Iran marked 'Persian Gulf Day' with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei declaring that new Iranian Hormuz management 'will bring calm' to the region. Iran's revised Hormuz peace proposal remained expected to be submitted to Pakistani mediators by May 1. UN High Commissioner Türk reported 21 executions in Iran since February 28, calling the continued rights abuses 'appalling' amid the war.
